subject: DPA artifact handover and verification loop
messages:
From: Rachel Park <rachel.park@acmehealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Artifact handover for DPA onboarding: evidence needed

Sean —

Thanks for the kickoff call yesterday. As part of Acme Health's DPA onboarding checklist we need a compact bundle of artifacts that demonstrates how Redwood handles PII for our workloads. Can you confirm you can produce the following by EOD Nov 15? If any item needs negotiation, flag it and we'll discuss: 

- Network/dataflow diagram showing ingress/egress and regions (PDF or PNG)
- Subprocessor roster + effective dates (CSV)
- KMS attestation or KMS key custody diagram (PDF)
- Access matrix (who can access PII, role justification)
- Sample audit log extract (sanitized) and retention policy excerpt
- Signed DPA Annex A evidence file (artifact + signer)

We prefer a single zip with named files and a manifest. If you need to share via a secure link (Drive/ShareFile), that's fine; provide link and access instructions.

Two clarifying Qs: are sanitized logs acceptable for the sample audit extract, or do you require raw records? Also — would Redwood be able to provide a short attestation (signed PDF) about subprocessor oversight?

Thanks,
Rachel Park
Privacy Program Lead
Acme Health
(privacy-requests@acmehealth.com)
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Park <rachel.park@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Nov 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Artifact handover for DPA onboarding: evidence needed

Rachel —

Appreciate the clear checklist. We can produce the bundle by Nov 15, with one ask: for the audit log sample, we can provide a sanitized extract (tokenized identifiers and time window) that preserves event types and source IPs but removes patient identifiers. If Acme requires raw logs for forensic reasons we can coordinate a controlled review session but that will take longer and will require an NDA addendum.

Planned deliverables (high level):
- redwood_dataflow_network_diagram_v1.pdf (region labels + egress flows)
- subprocessor_roster.csv (includes start/end dates)
- kms_key_custody_diagram.pdf + KMS attestation note (signed)
- access_matrix.csv (roles: infra, SRE, Product; justifications)
- audit_sample_sanitized.log (CSV)
- redwood_dpa_annex_A_evidence.zip (manifest inside)

I'll coordinate artifacts internally and share a secure Drive link. Quick question for your team: do you prefer a signer from our Security org (Laura Bennett) or Legal for the Annex A attestation?

I'll cc Laura to confirm signatory and to assign owners.

Thanks —
Sean
Director, Trust & Security
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Nov 2027 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Artifact handover for DPA onboarding: evidence needed

Team —

I'll sign the Annex A attestation on behalf of Security (we prefer consistency across onboarding). Marissa, please own the subprocessor roster and the KMS attestation package. Dylan, please prepare the access matrix and coordinate the sanitized audit extract with SRE. Sean, I'll review the manifest before we hand over.

Internal timeline:
- Nov 12: first drafts for diagram + roster + KMS note
- Nov 13: access matrix + sanitized log sample
- Nov 14: internal review and manifest build
- Nov 15 (EOD): upload zip + signed attestation to secure Drive, send link to Acme

Notes on format: manifest should be a simple CSV with columns (filename, SHA256, owner, description). For the KMS attestation we will include a short statement of key custody and HSM/KMS provider details, plus an extracted KMS policy snippet (no private keys).

Marissa/Team: add any blockers here.

- Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Security, Redwood Inference
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>

Subject: Fwd: Artifact handover for DPA onboarding: evidence needed

Rachel —

Attached is the bundle we discussed and the Drive link for download. Let me know if anything needs additional context.

Attachments (2):
- redwood_dpa_annex_A_evidence.zip (zip, ~12MB) — contains manifest.csv, redwood_dataflow_network_diagram_v1.pdf, kms_key_custody_diagram.pdf, KMS_attestation_signed.pdf, subprocessor_roster.csv
- access_matrix.csv (csv) — role, justification, least-privilege controls noted

Drive link (shared, view-only, expires 2028-01-15): https://drive.redwood.com/shared/AcmeHealth/DPA_evidence_20271115

Notes:
- audit_sample_sanitized.log is inside the zip (sanitized user identifiers replaced with stable pseudonyms, time window Nov 01-07, 2027).
- For forensic/raw log review we are open to a scheduled controlled session under a short scoped NDA if Acme needs it.
- If you confirm the attestation signer is acceptable (Laura Bennett, Head of Security), we'll provide a countersigned PDF and track this in HubSpot (HS-ACME-1427).
